section.content: 本申请涉及一种锂离子电池，其特征在于，采用Y‑CoFe2O4/γ‑MnO2作为负极材料，其制备工艺如下：将硝酸钴、硝酸铁以及醋酸钇溶于去离子水中，随后加入六亚甲基四胺和尿素，搅拌均匀，将混合液置于高压水热反应釜中进行水热反应，温度为180‑200摄氏度，反应时间为10‑20h；得到纳米球状的Y掺杂CoFe2O4；将Y掺杂CoFe2O4采用去离子水和乙醇交替洗涤，随后溶于乙二醇中形成悬浮液，在悬浮液中加入高锰酸钾和甘氨酸，90‑100摄氏度下加热回流12‑20h，产物在200‑400℃下煅烧30‑60min，从而得到纳米核壳球状的Y掺杂CoFe2O4/γ‑MnO2。

The application relates to a lithium ion battery, which is characterized in that Y-CoFe is adopted 2 O 4 /γ‑MnO 2 As a negative electrode material, the preparation process comprises the following steps: dissolving cobalt nitrate, ferric nitrate and yttrium acetate in deionized water, then adding hexamethylenetetramine and urea, uniformly stirring, placing the mixed solution in a high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction at the temperature of 180-200 ℃ for 10-20h; obtaining the nano-spherical Y-doped CoFe 2 O 4 (ii) a Doping Y with CoFe 2 O 4 Washing with deionized water and ethanol alternately, dissolving in ethylene glycol to form suspension, adding potassium permanganate and glycine into the suspension, heating and refluxing at 90-100 deg.C for 12-20h, and calcining the product at 200-400 deg.C for 30-60min to obtain spherical Y-doped CoFe with nano core-shell 2 O 4 /γ‑MnO 2 。

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The invention relates to a lithium ion secondary battery, in particular to a cathode material with a hollow core-shell sphere structure and a preparation method thereof.

Background

With the increasing aggravation of the problems of the lack of traditional fossil energy, environmental pollution, climate warming and the like, a novel environment-friendly energy technology also becomes one of the hotspots of the current development and application; rechargeable lithium ion secondary batteries have been widely used in portable electronic devices, electric tools, energy storage devices, electric vehicles, and hybrid electric vehicles due to their advantages of high operating voltage, high specific energy, high specific power, long cycle life, low self-discharge, no memory effect, etc.

The nanoscale transition metal oxides have attracted much attention in recent years due to their high theoretical specific capacity. However, there are a series of problems in using it as a negative electrode material: (1) poor electronic conductivity; (2) The circulation process has obvious volume expansion/contraction phenomenon, thereby causing pulverization of the electrode material and influencing multiplying power and circulation performance.

Disclosure of Invention

A lithium ion battery is characterized in that Y-CoFe is adopted 2 O 4 /γ-MnO 2 As a negative electrode material, the preparation process comprises the following steps:

dissolving cobalt nitrate, ferric nitrate and yttrium acetate in deionized waterThen adding hexamethylenetetramine and urea, uniformly stirring, and placing the mixed solution into a high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction at the temperature of 180-200 ℃ for 10-20 hours; obtaining the nano-spherical Y-doped CoFe 2 O 4 ；

Doping Y with CoFe 2 O 4 Washing with deionized water and ethanol alternately, dissolving in ethylene glycol to form suspension, adding potassium permanganate and glycine into the suspension, heating and refluxing at 90-100 deg.C for 12-20h, and calcining the product at 200-400 deg.C for 30-60min to obtain spherical Y-doped CoFe with nano core-shell 2 O 4 /γ-MnO 2 。

Preferably, the molar ratio of cobalt nitrate, ferric nitrate and yttrium acetate is 1: (0.05-0.1);

preferably, the molar ratio of the cobalt nitrate to the hexamethylenetetramine to the urea is 1: (0.1-1): (0.1-1);

preferably, the spherical Y-doped CoFe with nanometer core shell 2 O 4 /γ-MnO 2 The particle size is 10-30nm.

Has the beneficial effects that:

adding hexamethylenetetramine and urea in the hydrothermal process to obtain the hollow-structure nano-scale Y-doped CoFe 2 O 4 The nano hollow structure has larger specific surface area, so that the contact area of the material and the electrolyte is increased, the transmission speed of lithium ions is increased, and MnO is facilitated 2 Highly dispersed loading of (2); y doping of CoFe 2 O 4 The crystal lattice is beneficial to further improving the ion transmission efficiency; the hollow structure solves the problem of CoFe 2 O 4 Easy pulverization in the circulation process, thereby improving the circulation performance and stability of the battery.

Drawings

FIG. 1 shows the doping of Y with CoFe in example 1 of this application 2 O 4 /γ-MnO 2 SEM image of (d).

Detailed Description

Example 1

10mmol of cobalt nitrate, 20mmol of ferric nitrate and 0.5mmol of yttrium acetate are dissolved in 20ml of deionized waterThen adding 3mmol of hexamethylenetetramine and 8mmol of urea, uniformly stirring, and placing the mixed solution in a high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction at 180 ℃ for 10 hours; obtaining hollow nano spherical Y-doped CoFe 2 O 4 ；

Doping Y with CoFe 2 O 4 Washing with deionized water and ethanol alternately, dissolving in 20ml of ethylene glycol to form a suspension, adding 3mmol of potassium permanganate and 1mmol of glycine into the suspension, heating and refluxing at 100 ℃ for 12h, and calcining the product at 250 ℃ for 30min to obtain the spherical Y-doped CoFe with the nano core-shell 2 O 4 /γ-MnO 2 。

Comparative example 1

Dissolving 10mmol of cobalt nitrate, 20mmol of ferric nitrate and 0.5mmol of yttrium acetate in 20ml of deionized water, then adding 3mmol of hexamethylenetetramine and 8mmol of urea, stirring uniformly, placing the mixed solution in a high-pressure hydrothermal reaction kettle for hydrothermal reaction at 180 ℃ for 10 hours; calcining the product at 250 ℃ for 30min to obtain hollow nano-spherical Y-doped CoFe 2 O 4 。

Comparative example 2

Adding 3mmol of potassium permanganate and 1mmol of glycine into 20ml of ethylene glycol, heating and refluxing for 12h at 100 ℃, and calcining the product for 30min at 250 ℃ to obtain gamma-MnO 2 。

Comparative example 3

It differs from comparative example 1 in that yttrium acetate was not added.

The active materials of the above examples and comparative examples were mixed with a conductive agent acetylene black, a binder PVDF at a ratio of 8. The button cell is formed by taking the lithium sheet as a negative electrode, a lithium sheet as a counter electrode, PP as a diaphragm and 1M LiPF6-EC/DMC/DMC (volume ratio 1.
